title: trading related ai/ml enabled financial model.
author: Pleasant_Yogurt8145
selftext: this is the basic the basic crux of my existing model, now please understand i dont know how to code at all i am using ai for coding and moreover i want variance and uniqueness in my bots and i am unable to get it help me and give me some direction as on what should i do it, kindly helo me - A **six-layer neural investment architecture** processing 50+ data inputs across fundamental, technical, sentiment, macro, geopolitical, and alternative domains. Stocks pass **10 quantitative gates**, then score across **valuation, momentum, risk, thematic, and macro layers** using sigmoid activation to produce a **Composite Stock Score (0-1.0)**. Position sizing uses **half-Kelly criterion**. Scientific concepts from materials science, neuroscience, quantum physics, and evolutionary biology map to stock properties. **Five feedback loops** enable continuous learning. **Regime detection** across five macro states adjusts allocations dynamically. Focus: **small-cap turning midcap** with foreign exposure, innovation, and management quality as core pillars with 25 normal agents with uniqueness of atleast 70% and 5 compliance and 5 financial ratios audit agents.
